## Activity

During April 2019, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 88 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and the subsequent image-quality and grading outcomes. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the proportion of images that could not be assessed and the number that produced referable results.

## Image quality

Of the 88 captures, 1 was recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.1 per cent. The result indicates that nearly all captures were suitable for grading. The ungradable capture remains included in the activity total and is reported separately to support monitoring of image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results from the April 2019 activity. The median lag between capture and grading was 7 days. This measure summarises the time taken for results to progress from image capture to grading during the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag provide a summary of grading outcomes and reporting timeliness for Oakridge Primary Care.
